NAI_PORT.title: Web Port
NAI_PORT.description: Port for the nAI web interface and API

SHARES_PATH.title: Shares Folder
SHARES_PATH.description: Folder containing your NithronOS shares. It is mounted read-only; add individual shares as sources in nAI.

LLM_ENABLED.title: Generated Answers
LLM_ENABLED.description: Use a language model to write answers. When off, nAI answers with quotes from your files.

LLM_PROVIDER.title: Model Provider
LLM_PROVIDER.description: ollama (local or on another PC), openai (any OpenAI-compatible server: vLLM, llama.cpp, LM Studio, or the OpenAI API), anthropic

LLM_BASE_URL.title: Model Server URL
LLM_BASE_URL.description: e.g. http://192.168.1.50:11434 for Ollama on a gaming PC. The default reaches Ollama running on the NAS itself.

LLM_MODEL.title: Model
LLM_MODEL.description: 'auto' picks the largest installed Ollama model that fits the hardware. Otherwise a model name, e.g. qwen3:8b

LLM_API_KEY.title: API Key
LLM_API_KEY.description: Only for cloud providers. Your questions and matching passages are sent to that provider.

RERANKER.title: Reranking
RERANKER.description: Sharper result ordering at some CPU cost. 'auto' enables it on capable hardware.

OCR_ENABLED.title: Read Scans (OCR)
OCR_ENABLED.description: Extract text from scanned PDFs and photos of documents

OCR_LANGUAGES.title: OCR Languages
OCR_LANGUAGES.description: Tesseract language codes. The image ships English and German.

PUID.title: User ID
PUID.description: User ID nAI runs as. It needs read access to the shares you want to index.

TRUSTED_PROXIES.title: Trusted Proxies
TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: JSON list of reverse-proxy IPs/CIDRs whose X-Forwarded-For header is trusted for rate limiting. The default covers Docker networks (where Caddy's traffic comes from).

MEMORY_LIMIT.title: Memory Limit
MEMORY_LIMIT.description: Container memory limit. nAI peaks around 1.4 GB with reranking on; give it more for very large shares.

CPU_LIMIT.title: CPU Limit
CPU_LIMIT.description: CPU cores nAI may use (indexing and OCR are CPU-heavy)
